record.reason: SynerDiff is a continuous-batching scheduler for diffusion-model serving, reporting 1.6x throughput and up to 78.7% lower latency through UNet/VAE scheduling. The system-level batching ideas may transfer to serving, and the candidate is linked to LLM scheduling, but its experiments and resource bottlenecks are specific to diffusion image generation rather than LLM inference.
record.title: SynerDiff: Synergetic Continuous Batching for Fast and Parallel Diffusion Model Inference
